title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. translated_title: 每条边都需要引用：利用语言模型智能体构建以引用为依据的医疗软件采用知识图谱
translated_abstract: 医院需要定期采购临床医生和患者赖以使用的软件。由于这些采购成本高昂、难以逆转，且可能影响患者护理，采购方需要寻找证据来确认哪些同行机构已经在使用某款产品，以及该产品与哪些系统相连接。这些证据是公开的，但分散在供应商网站、新闻稿和第三方页面中。语言模型智能体现在能够以低成本收集这些信息，但提取出的声明的正确性难以核实，而错误列出的客户信息可能会误导采购方并损害机构声誉。我们提出了一个从开放网络构建客户关系与集成关系知识图谱的流水线，遵循一条规则：每条边都必须由来自其源页面的逐字引用来支持。页面来源于对每个供应商网站的确定性爬取，以及一个在预算限制内搜索网络其余部分的ReAct智能体。一个宽松的提取器提出带有引用的关系，随后……
tldr: 该论文提出一个从开放网络构建医疗软件客户与集成关系知识图谱的流水线，要求每条边都必须有源页面的逐字引用支持，从而确保语言模型智能体提取的信息可验证、可追溯。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of healthcare software customer and integration relations from the open web, requiring every edge to be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page to ensure verifiable and traceable claim extraction by language-model agents.
